definitions: Communication or cooperation which facilitates a close working relationship between people or organisations.
A person who acts as a link to assist communication or cooperation between groups.
A sexual relationship, especially one that is secret and involves people who are not married to each other.
The binding or thickening agent used in sauces.
examples: He served as a liaison to the press.
A secret liaison with a colleague.
Add a cream and egg yolk liaison.
